item.description: Mathis Valin opened his 2026 season this Sunday at Pernes-les-Fontaines, lining up against a handful of MXGP world championship frontrunners. item.title: Video: 737 Performance – back racing EMX125 in 2026
item.description: The 737 Performance KTM team are back in the GP paddock for the 2026 season under the watchful eye of former GP rider, Valentin Teillet. Rafael Mennillo, Leo Diss-Fenard and Eliot Buysschaert will be under the awning to take on the EMX125 series.

item.title: Interview: Thibault Benistant – “I felt comfortable on the 450cc right from the start”

item.title: Gallery: Ducati ready to take on MXGP in 2026
item.description: It’s a new chapter for Ducati as they enter the MXGP World Championship with Louis Vosters taking over the reigns for the 2026 season. The team have signed up Andrea Bonacorsi and Calvin Vlaanderen to team up with Jeremy Seewer. See images from their recent photoshoot courtesy of Davide Messora – Ducati Corse OffRoad.
